text:
Lakers announce 2026 Emirates NBA Cup group play schedule and opponents
The Los Angeles Lakers announced their 2026 Emirates NBA Cup group play schedule on Aug. 12, outlining four games that will determine whether they advance in the tournament. The Lakers are placed in West Group C alongside the San Antonio Spurs, Golden State Warriors, Portland Trail Blazers, and Sacramento Kings.
The format for this year’s Emirates NBA Cup remains largely unchanged from previous seasons. Each team will play four group stage games on designated 'Cup Nights' every Friday from Oct. 30 through Nov. 27, with two additional specialty Cup Nights scheduled for Nov. 23 and Nov. 24. Eight teams will move on to the knockout stage: six group winners and one wildcard team from each conference.
Quarterfinals and semifinals are set to take place in home markets, while the final is scheduled for Dec. 11 at Hinkle Fieldhouse in Indianapolis, Indiana.
The Lakers begin their campaign on Oct. 30 against the Warriors at Chase Center in San Francisco, followed by a home game against the Trail Blazers on Nov. 6 at Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles. They host the Kings on Nov. 20 before finishing group play against the Spurs in San Antonio on Nov. 27.
Last season, the Lakers went undefeated during group play but were eliminated by the Spurs in the quarterfinals; San Antonio advanced to face the New York Knicks in the final after defeating Los Angeles.
This year’s competition features a strong field: The Spurs are defending Western Conference Champions; Portland returns Damian Lillard from injury and has acquired Ja Morant; Golden State continues to be led by Stephen Curry; while new additions like Walker Kessler, Quentin Grimes, and Collin Sexton join Luka Doncic and Austin Reaves as part of a retooled Lakers roster.
